title: Gregg Hull
intro:
Gregg Hull (Republican Party) is running for election for Governor of New Mexico. He is on the ballot on a joint ticket with David M. Gallegos in the general election on November 3, 2026. He advanced from the Republican primary on June 2, 2026.
Hull completed Ballotpedia's Candidate Connection survey in 2026. Click here to read the survey answers.
